Definition: properly, to plait together, i.e. (figuratively) to augment (especially in number or quantity, to accumulate)
BiblicalUsage: Kabar means to plait together, and so to add to or multiply — Elihu's charge is that Job multiplies words without knowledge, plaiting speech upon speech.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that more words are not more wisdom, and God is not impressed by a long argument that says nothing.
